target.title: fix(exec): require approval for OpenClaw lifecycle commands
target.body:
﻿Fixes #99518

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running exec commands through gateway or node hosts could have OpenClaw gateway/daemon lifecycle mutations handled by normal allowlist or auto-review paths when the command should require explicit approval.

The affected workflow is OpenClaw self-management from exec surfaces: stopping, starting, restarting, running, deleting, or uninstalling the gateway/daemon through CLI, launchctl, systemctl, schtasks, process-kill, shell-wrapper, package-manager, Windows shim, `env -S`, `sudo`/`doas`, and dispatch-wrapper commands.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a focused lifecycle classifier to the exec approval policy and wires it into both gateway-host and node-host approval analysis. The guard forces explicit approval for OpenClaw lifecycle mutations unless exec is already in yolo mode (`security=full`, `ask=off`).

Read-only lifecycle inspection remains outside the guard, including `openclaw gateway status`, `launchctl print`, `systemctl status`, `schtasks /Query`, and generic read-only process lookups. The parser also preserves empty argv tokens and source argv so wrapper forms such as `env -a "" ...` are classified the same way they execute.

## User Impact

Operators get an extra human confirmation before an agent or auto-review path can stop, start, restart, run, delete, or uninstall the OpenClaw gateway/daemon in non-yolo configurations. Existing yolo-mode behavior and read-only status/query commands are unchanged.

## Evidence

Real behavior proof from the node-host `system.run` entrypoint after this patch:

```json
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "label": "auto mutating lifecycle",
      "ok": false,
      "error": "SYSTEM_RUN_DENIED: approval required",
      "autoReviewerCalls": 0,
      "runCommandCalls": 0,
      "deniedReasons": ["approval-required"],
      "stdout": null
    },
    {
      "label": "auto read-only lifecycle status",
      "ok": true,
      "error": null,
      "autoReviewerCalls": 1,
      "runCommandCalls": 1,
      "deniedReasons": [],
      "stdout": "auto read-only lifecycle status-ran"
    },
    {
      "label": "full mode lifecycle unchanged",
      "ok": true,
      "error": null,
      "autoReviewerCalls": 0,
      "runCommandCalls": 1,
      "deniedReasons": [],
      "stdout": "full mode lifecycle unchanged-ran"
    },
    {
      "label": "auto sudo env lifecycle",
      "ok": false,
      "error": "SYSTEM_RUN_DENIED: approval required",
      "autoReviewerCalls": 0,
      "runCommandCalls": 0,
      "deniedReasons": ["approval-required"],
      "stdout": null
    }
  ]
}
```

Focused tests:

```shell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle|env -S|outer env|incoming env|visible wrapper|nested env -S|bare variables|escaped env|escaped variables|lifecycle positions|unknown env|benign env|retokenize|single quotes|carrier OpenClaw|comment|assignments|option positions|flock|sudo|shell wrapper|shell multiplexer|supported shell|process target|process option variable|process option value|process flag|shell-prefix|systemctl|rescan|backslash escapes|backslash markers|empty command|FOO=bar|quoted|assignment operands|unsupported shell|bare|incoming shell|missing env|read-only or generic|assignments after --|dash-prefixed env|value-taking sudo|unresolved env"
# Tests  170 passed | 67 skipped (237)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/node-host/invoke-system-run.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle|empty env operands"
# Tests  2 passed | 33 skipped (35)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Tests  3 passed | 53 skipped (56)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Tests  1 passed | 48 skipped (49)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/utils/utils-misc.test.ts --testNamePattern="splitShellArgs"
# Tests  4 passed | 9 skipped (13)
```

Static checks:

```shell
pnpm exec oxlint src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node-phases.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.ts src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts src/infra/exec-approvals.ts src/node-host/invoke-system-run.test.ts src/node-host/invoke-system-run.ts src/utils/shell-argv.ts src/utils/utils-misc.test.ts
# passed

git diff --check
# passed
```

Autoreview:

```shell
python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local --no-web-search
```

Multiple local autoreview passes ran before this update and each accepted finding was fixed with regression coverage, including sudo/doas assignment propagation, `env -S --` assignment operands, system.run empty-token/source-argv handling, Windows-path backslash marker restoration, shell-wrapper env expansion, unknown assignment sentinels, and sudo value-taking options. The final clean rerun could not complete because the Codex review subprocess hit a usage limit and reported the next retry window as `Jul 9th, 2026 8:13 AM`; this PR therefore does not claim a final clean autoreview result yet.
